businessModel: Free software; funded by the developer and donations
summary: Privacy Browser Android is a WebView-based browser from Soren Stoutner. Version 3.20 added a filter-list system modelled on its PC sibling, and the 4.x series will move to a forked Privacy WebView.
bestFor: Android users who want a locked-down, open-source browser
People who want per-site control over JavaScript
notFor: Anyone who wants a full daily browser with sync and extensions
People on Android 9 or older after 3.21

pros.title: Strict defaults
pros.detail: JavaScript, DOM storage and cookies are off until you allow them.

pros.title: Filter lists
pros.detail: Version 3.20 added a Filter Lists Activity modelled on Privacy Browser PC.

pros.title: Open source and no trackers
pros.detail: GPL-licensed and distributed on F-Droid and Google Play.

cons.title: Many sites need JavaScript
cons.detail: Enabling it per site is required for much of the modern web.

cons.title: WebView-bound
cons.detail: Depends on the system WebView, which now only supports Android 10+, so 3.21 will raise the minimum API to 29.

cons.title: Single-developer project
cons.detail: Release pace and Amazon listing (still 3.19.3) can lag.
